cohort: The study enrolled 60 pregnant women aged over 18 who delivered at SMGS Hospital, GMC Jammu between December 2019 to November 2020.
finding: The study identified younger maternal age, primiparity, preterm birth, lower segment cesarean section, anemia, previous cesarean section, pregnancy-induced hypertension/pre-eclampsia, placental abruption, and premature rupture of membranes as significant risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Lower segment cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for postpartum hemorrhage.
